Vision & Mission

Vision

To become a respected educational institution in Eastern Visayas that develops skilled, disciplined, and service-oriented graduates who contribute to the community and the nation.

Mission

To provide quality and accessible education through strong academic instruction, values formation, leadership training, and community service.
